description:
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Pentavus's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite creature token.
Activate Pentavus's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Pentavite.
When the Pentavite dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Resolve the Pentavus ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.name: Pyramid of the Pantheon
uses.cardState: with three or more brick counters on it
